The '''Bazurkah Clan''' or '''Bazurkah family''' was a crime family of [[Dug/Legends|Dugs]] on [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]]. It was headed by [[Bazurkah]] as of [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. A rivalry developed between the Bazurkah Clan and the Ruhx family after the Ruhx "insulted" the Bazurkah. Each family placed bounties on the other. [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] accepted bounties from both families and killed both Bazurkah and [[Bog'Ruhx]].
